conditions.cpu_and_io_scope: Shared node; CPUs not exclusively pinned and background host load not controlled.
conditions.bootstrap_scope: Ephemeral Ubuntu dependency bootstrap is included in Pod time; SDK venv is fixed/read-only.
conditions.os_page_cache: uncontrolled/shared; empty is not globally cold
conditions.prepopulation_note: Explicit node chunk-cache priming precedes the trigger and counts in Pod time.
conditions.scope: Colocated POSIX artifact delivery + actual native decode, not network or HTTP gateway TTFT.
conditions.upload_weights_s_note: Includes host layout and H2D; not a pure DMA timer.
conditions.phase_note: Only trigger_to_first_partition is an additive partition. Other phases overlap it.
conditions.pod_clock_note: Actual API creationTimestamp and synchronized hosts; pairwise UTC skew bound unknown.
conditions.reference_parity: All 32 target integer token IDs equal independently fresh B4/S512; not a dense-logit claim.
